source_requirements.identity: Only an article-index entry whose exactInfoboxItemIds contains the numeric itemId may support that row. Never join by display name, page title similarity, family hint, or alternate-id lookup.
source_requirements.semantic: Wiki categories and baseline preset tags never prove role. Use exact variant infobox parameters together with article mechanics prose.
source_requirements.citation: Each decisive Wiki fact includes the revision redirect URL, revision ID, local raw-text SHA-256, exact item ID, and a short literal excerpt from that article revision.
source_requirements.uncertainty: If no exact article or variant-specific functional detail is available, emit unresolved and state the evidence gap.

currency.predicate: The exact item is spendable/exchangeable value used for purchases, access, charges, or a documented reward shop. A single quest proof, cosmetic, loot, edible item, task cargo, or reward container is not currency.

rune.predicate: The exact item functions as a reusable or consumable spellcasting rune or a documented rune substitute; its role is active magic supply rather than an item whose name merely contains rune.

runecrafting-focus.predicate: The exact talisman/tiara/focus grants access to a Runecraft altar; it stays distinct from spellcasting runes and is filed with skilling tools.

rune-container.predicate: The exact pouch stores spellcasting runes or permits casting from stored runes; it is grouped with rune supplies.

runecrafting-utility.predicate: The exact item provides a Runecraft-specific production aid, such as binding combination runes, and belongs with skilling tools.

teleport.predicate: The exact item itself offers active or rechargeable movement between locations. An uncharged but rechargeable device remains teleport gear; decorative animation props and quest records do not.

teleport-tablet.predicate: The exact tablet is consumed or activated to move the player, boat, or another explicitly supported transport target.

teleport-scroll.predicate: The exact scroll can be activated to move the player to a named destination.

teleport-charge.predicate: The exact item is a charge or consumable whose documented primary function performs a teleport.

teleport-container.predicate: The exact container stores, selects, or dispatches usable teleport scrolls or destinations.

transport-access.predicate: The exact item grants or installs access to a documented player transport network or portal.

correction_rules.match: Exact article says this is a quest item whose only documented function is consumed/given during one quest step, with no repeatable exchange or usable currency value.
Exact article says this is an unobtainable purchase-state marker or inert store interface token with no bankable exchange role.
Exact article identifies a skillcape as wearable skill-training gear.
Exact article identifies a Western Provinces banner as a combat spear-like weapon.
Exact article identifies a white pearl as edible healing food.
Exact article identifies a courier crate as task cargo that must be delivered by boat and is not a transport item or spendable currency.
Exact article identifies an item as a construction blueprint/schematic used to build a portal, not a usable teleport or an installed access network.
Exact article identifies a tablet as a quest transcript/lore collectible and documents no transport action.
Exact article identifies a temporary teleport-animation prop that is not obtainable and performs no transport action itself.
Exact article identifies a drink whose effect is Sailing experience or another consumable effect rather than transport.

evidence_limits: Exact variant ID plus an article page does not prove primary role unless the cited mechanic supports it.
Rechargeable depleted devices are not junk when the article documents restoration and the same transport function.
Quest association alone never makes an item quest-only; repeatable shop/exchange mechanics preserve currency status.
A reward token/container is not currency unless the article documents its use as exchange value.
Runecrafting talismans and tiaras are focus tools, not spellcasting consumables.
Internal item identifiers, dummy selections, and alternate IDs without an exact variant record remain unresolved.
